evidence: The plan states its own safe area as "Text safe area: keep all burned-in text within the 1080×1420 center band (clear of Instagram's top ~250px and bottom ~250px UI chrome)" — a bottom clearance of only ~250px (bottom boundary ~1670px on a 1920px canvas) and a caption y-position of "y=1500" in the drawtext commands, both of which sit below/at the required bottom ≤ 1500px safe-zone boundary rather than keeping burned-in text above it.
